domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, manager decision, and potential cancellation. The status field drives all workflow transitions.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT: Initial state when employee begins creating a leave request. Editable by the employee. Not visible to managers.
SUBMITTED: Employee has formally submitted the request for review. Locked for employee edits. Visible to the employee's manager for action.
APPROVED: Manager has approved the request. The employee's leave balance is decremented. The request becomes part of the employee's leave history.
REJECTED: Manager has declined the request with a mandatory rejection reason. No balance impact. Terminal state (no further transitions).
CANCELLED: The request has been withdrawn. If previously APPROVED, the balance is restored. Terminal state.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Catalog of leave categories available in the system. Each LeaveType has an associated LeavePolicy that governs its rules. The code field is the canonical identifier used in business logic.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: The leave type is available for employees to request.
INACTIVE: The leave type has been disabled. Existing requests retain their type but new requests cannot use it.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days are granted, whether accrual applies, notice requirements, and whether manager approval is mandatory. Referenced by LeaveBalance to compute remaining days.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: The policy is in effect and governs leave requests of its associated type.
INACTIVE: The policy has been retired. Existing balances under this policy are preserved but new requests cannot reference it.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining days for a specific policy within a fiscal year. Updated atomically when leave is approved or cancelled. One balance record per employee-policy-fiscalYear combination.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Balance is tracked for the current fiscal year. Leave requests draw from this balance.
EXHAUSTED: remainingDays has reached zero. No further leave of this type can be approved until the next accrual cycle or fiscal year reset.
CLOSED: The fiscal year has ended. The balance record is archived and immutable. A new balance record is created for the new fiscal year.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. The managerId establishes the reporting relationship used for leave approval routing. employmentStatus gates eligibility for leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Employee is currently employed and eligible to request leave.
INACTIVE: Employee is on extended absence (e.g., long-term leave). Leave requests are blocked.
TERMINATED: Employment has ended. All leave balances are frozen. No new requests allowed.

business_rules: BR-001 — Employee Eligibility: Only employees with employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE' may submit a leave request. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are blocked from creating or submitting requests.

BR-002 — Date Validation: startDate must be on or after the current date (no backdated leave requests). endDate must be on or after startDate. The total requested days (inclusive of start and end) must be greater than zero.

BR-003 — Balance Sufficiency: Before a leave request can transition from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the employee's LeaveBalance for the corresponding policy and fiscal year must have remainingDays >= the number of calendar days requested (excluding weekends/holidays per policy configuration). If insufficient, the request must be REJECTED.

BR-004 — Manager Approval Routing: When a leave request is SUBMITTED, it is routed to the employee's manager (identified by employee.managerId). Only the designated manager (or a user with a role that subsumes manager authority) may APPROVE or REJECT the request. An employee may not approve their own request.
BR-005 — Mandatory Rejection Reason: When a manager transitions a request to REJECTED, a rejectionReason must be provided. The field is required and non-empty for this transition.

BR-006 — Balance Deduction on Approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the corresponding LeaveBalance.usedDays is incremented by the number of approved leave days, and remainingDays is recalculated (totalEntitlement - usedDays). This must happen atomically within the same transaction.
